genre.en: contemporary dance performance photography: stage light cutting through haze, motion caught mid-move

s: a dancer's bare feet mid-step on a worn maple studio floor, a terracotta-orange mirror-less wall behind, hard late-afternoon sun from a tall window on the left stretching the body's shadow long across the boards, the body filling most of the frame

a woman in work clothes caught mid-sway in her own small apartment living room, a deep sea-blue painted wall behind her, one hard lamp-like beam of evening sun from the right throwing a crisp full-length shadow of her arms across the wall, tight close framing

a group of after-work students mid-movement in a community-hall class, a tomato-red curtain behind them, a single hard shaft of light from a high side window carving sharp overlapping shadows on the wooden floor, the nearest body large in the foreground

a pair of hands mid-sweep, blurred at the fingertips, in a real dance studio with a terracotta-orange wall, hard low sun from the left window casting the arm's long sharp shadow across the wood floor, the moving body filling most of the frame

a woman who just got off work, tie-less shirt and bag dropped on the floor, caught mid-turn in a neighborhood studio against a deep sea-blue wall, one hard overhead spotlight-like shaft of window light from the upper right throwing her crisp shadow beside her, her figure large and close

the class in session on a rooftop terrace at dusk, students mid-flow in a staggered row against a mint-green painted wall, hard low sun from behind the camera right throwing long sharp shadows of every raised arm across the concrete floor, the front student large in frame

a close crop of bare feet shifting weight on a bathroom-tile-patterned studio floor in tomato red and cream, the shoes kicked aside, hard sunlight from a side door slicing across the tiles and casting the ankles' shadows long and sharp

a person sitting on a sofa phone in hand then abruptly rising into a stretch in a small apartment, a mustard-yellow wall behind, hard evening sun from the window on the left throwing a big, clear silhouette shadow on the wall, the body filling the frame
